headline: Auction sales drop below one-third for first time
caption: East Auckland property market update: auction clearance rates have fallen below 33% for the first time in over a year, with fewer properties coming to market. If you're thinking about selling, this tells us buyers are being more selective—which means smart pricing and presentation are more important than ever. Let's chat about your property's best strategy! 🏡
original_title: Auction sales rate falls below a third for the first time in over a year
